title: Aligning Silver Support Scheme's Monthly Income Threshold with Local Qualifying Salary Quantum
what_it_is: Aligning Silver Support Scheme's Monthly Income Threshold with Local Qualifying Salary Quantum

sections.label: Silver Support PCHI and flat types
sections.summary: The monthly PCHI is gross household income divided by family members, and Silver Support payouts are tiered by flat type and PCHI.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: I hope that this can be a point of clarification for the Member.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: This monthly PCHI is computed as the total gross household monthly income, divided by the total number of family members living together in the same household.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Our Silver Support Scheme payouts are tiered by flat types – so, a 5-room flat, 4-room flat, 3-room flat, 2-room flat – they are tiered by the different flat types and of course, the monthly PCHI.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: This is to ensure that the support is targeted most at seniors who now have little or no family support and resources in their retirement.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: It is to ensure that firms who wish to employ foreign workers also pay their local workers meaningfully, rather than on token salaries.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: It is not intended as a measure of retirement adequacy or financial need and is therefore not correlated with the Silver Support Scheme's monthly PCHI criteria.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As I have earlier on answered Assoc Prof Jamus Lim's Parliamentary Question (PQ) and also responded to the supplementary question by Mr Shawn Loh, we recently enhanced the Silver Support Scheme, just last year, in 2025, and we raised the qualifying monthly PCHI threshold from $1,800 to $2,300.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: This has enabled more seniors, including those with lower incomes, to qualify for Silver Support payouts.

sections.label: No statistics on LQS threshold
sections.summary: The speaker does not have statistics on how much the LQS pushed elderly seniors living alone below the $1,500 monthly PCHI threshold.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: To his point about how much of the LQS has pushed the elderly seniors living alone down to below or set at that monthly PCHI threshold of $1,500, I do not have those statistics because it is not how we work that scheme out to be.
